description: Unstaggered horizontal computational grid for the CAS-LSM land-surface component of FGOALS-g3.5, using the gamil2x2 grid geometry registered as g257. The full horizontal grid contains 180 longitude points and 80 latitude points, with uniform 2-degree longitudinal spacing and non-uniform meridional spacing. Land-surface scalar states and surface momentum flux components are represented at the same horizontal grid locations. The atmospheric U and V wind components supplied to CAS-LSM are also associated with these land grid locations; no separate horizontally staggered velocity grids are used by the land component. Land units, soil columns and plant functional types represent subgrid heterogeneity within this horizontal grid.
